articles.title: Beyond Batteries: The Supercapacitor Revolution
articles.summary:
Supercapacitors have always been known for their ability to charge and discharge rapidly. But today, researchers are asking a bigger question: can they store significantly more energy without losing that speed?

New porous carbons, pseudocapacitive materials, advanced electrolytes, and hybrid designs are bringing that possibility closer. The future of supercapacitors may not be about replacing batteries but about working alongside them to make energy systems faster, smarter, and more efficient.

The next revolution may not be about replacing batteries.

It may be about making energy storage smarter.
